newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Most bids lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Most bids lower.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids were lower Wednesday, mostly in line with losses on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange, dealers said.
The MGE December contract closed down 2 3/4 cents per bushel at 4.20 1/2, and March settled down 5 cents at 3.87.
The upcoming U.S. Thanksgiving on Thurday also kept trade in cash grain markets quiet, dealers said.
"We saw very few receipts today (Wednesday)," said one Montana-based dealer. "The spot market rolled over to the March contract, and that was the big excitement."
However, another dealer in Montana reported heavy spring wheat movement.
"It's been busier than it has been in awhile," the dealer said. "We've seen a lot of mill business."
